clues: This city sits in the south west of Spain, by the sea. Two rivers meet the ocean here, in the Gulf of Cádiz.
In this hot, dry-summer land, snow is a rare, rare sight. Two big falls, in 1954 and in 1991, are still told of here.
Sailors from Phoenicia set up a firm colony here long ago. They came by sea in the ninth century BC and stayed.
The oldest football club in all of Spain has its home here. That first club still plays in this port town.
Ships and mines shaped this port town of the modern age. Copper dug up-river paid for much of its growth and work.
